svg.title: The data model: who owns what, and how it connects
svg.desc: Three owners, from shared to private. Enable keeps one record for each hotel, shared by every agency. The agency keeps its programmes, its terms for each hotel under each programme, in gold because the agency has checked them, and the offers it receives. One advisor keeps their notes, their travellers, and their trips, made of lines. Each trip line links to the hotel's record, so the commission, the extras and the offer reach the trip from one place. Every value is a field with its layer, its source and when it was last checked.
